if(c.length<20)return null; const sma=n=>c.slice(-n).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/n; const f=sma(5),slow=sma(20),last=c.at(-1),prev=c.at(-2); let g=0,l=0; for(let i=Math.max(1,c.length-14);i<c.length;i++){const d=c[i]-c[i-1];if(d>0)g+=d;else l-=d;} const rs=l===0?100:(g/14)/(l/14); const rsi=100-(100/(1+rs)); const mom=(last-prev)/prev; return {f,slow,last,rsi,mom};} for(let i=0;i<inputs.length;i++){const instId=meta[i]?.json?.instId;const raw=inputs[i]?.json?.data;if(!instId||!Array.isArray(raw))continue;const m=metrics(raw);if(!m)continue;if(s.position?.pair===instId&&(m.last<=Number(s.position.stopLoss)||m.last>=Number(s.position.takeProfit)||m.f<m.slow*.999||m.rsi<45)){openExit={instId,m,reason:m.last<=Number(s.position.stopLoss)?'Stop loss':m.last>=Number(s.position.takeProfit)?'Take profit':'Exit signal · RSI '+m.rsi.toFixed(1)};} if(!s.position&&m.f>m.slow*1.001&&m.mom>0.001&&m.rsi>=52&&m.rsi<=68){const conf=Math.min(.95,.66+(m.f/m.slow-1)*25+m.mom*18);candidates.push({instId,m,confidence:Number(conf.toFixed(2))});}} let side=null,pair=null,m=null,confidence=.7,reason='',amount=5; if(openExit){side='sell';pair=openExit.instId;m=openExit.m;confidence=.78;reason=openExit.reason;amount=Number(s.position.amountQuote||5);}else if(candidates.length){candidates.sort((a,b)=>b.confidence-a.confidence);const c=candidates[0];side='buy';pair=c.instId;m=c.m;confidence=c.confidence;amount=confidence>=.80?10:5;reason='Bullish 15m · RSI '+m.rsi.toFixed(1)+' · momentum '+(m.mom*100).toFixed(2)+'%';} if(!side){s.lastMarket={at:s.lastScanAt,marketOk:true,universe:meta.length};return [{json:{proposalCreated:false,reason:'NO_SIGNAL',scanned:meta.length}}];} const p={id:'J'+now+(side==='buy'?'B':'S'),side,pair,amountQuote:Math.min(10,Math.max(5,amount)),entry:m.last,stopLoss:side==='buy'?Number((m.last*.985).toFixed(8)):Number(s.position?.stopLoss||0),takeProfit:side==='buy'?Number((m.last*1.03).toFixed(8)):Number(s.position?.takeProfit||0),confidence,reason,createdAt:now,expiresAt:now+20*60*1000,status:'pending'}; s.pendingTrade=p;s.lastMarket={at:s.lastScanAt,marketOk:true,universe:meta.length,pair,last:m.last,rsi:m.rsi};s.lastEvent={at:new Date().toISOString(),message:side.toUpperCase()+' proposal '+pair};return [{json:{proposalCreated:true,proposal:p}}];

const s=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const p=$json.proposal; const ts=new Date().toISOString(); const path='/api/v5/trade/order'; let bodyObj={instId:p.pair,tdMode:'cash',side:p.side,ordType:'market',clOrdId:String(p.id).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g,'').slice(0,32)}; if(p.side==='buy'){bodyObj.sz=String(p.amountQuote);bodyObj.tgtCcy='quote_ccy';}else{const q=Number(s.position?.baseQty||0);if(!(q>0)||s.position?.pair!==p.pair)throw new Error('SELL_POSITION_MISMATCH');bodyObj.sz=String(Number((q*.99).toFixed(8)));bodyObj.tgtCcy='base_ccy';} const body=JSON.stringify(bodyObj);return [{json:{timestamp:ts,requestPath:path,prehash:ts+'POST'+path+body,body,proposal:p}}];
